This plot is very small, only a tenth of a hectare, and the crop is not my main one — it is something else I grow for the house. I went to school a little, so I know fertilizer helps, but one bag of DAP or urea is too much for such a small piece of land, and cash is tight. I own the land so I take care of it with manure from my animals, and I will use the seed I saved from last year like I always do. My husband and I will do the work ourselves; no need to hire anyone for such a small plot.
